title: TELEmedical competence network Antibiotic Stewardship in PEdiatRics - Cooperative Optimization of Network and Novel E-Health for Children’s Therapy
summary:
TeleKasper-Connect is a study in children's hospitals in Saxony-Anhalt. The aim is to improve the use of the TeleKasper app, which helps physicians correctly use antibiotics in their daily clinical practice. The app offers specialist information, dosage assistance, and the option of telemedical consultations with experts.
The study investigates which factors promote or hinder the use of the app. To this end, the number of clicks within the app is analyzed and participants are surveyed about their experiences. No patient data is collected. Participation is voluntary, safe, and involves minimal effort.
In the long term, the study aims to help improve the treatment of children with infections and make the use of antibiotics more targeted and safer.
conditions: Inappropriate antibiotic therapy for infectious diseases in childhood – particularly in the context of preventing antibiotic resistance and promoting rational prescribing decisions in inpatient pediatric care.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The study targets medical staff working in pediatric wards of the participating children's hospitals in Saxony-Anhalt, as well as pharmacists from these hospitals.
Included are individuals who, at the time of the baseline phase, potentially have access to the TeleKasper app in their daily clinical work and are registered as users. Active use of the app at the time of inclusion is not required.
Exclusion criteria:
Excluded are individuals without a medical or pharmaceutical license, as well as those working in institutions that are not among the clinics participating in the project.
